This represented an improvement over the previous "moderate" assessment, reflecting

reduced estimates of the cost of a potential financial sector shock and an increase in the

discount rate used. Baseline external public debt indicators showed that external debt

dynamics were broadly sound and remained resilient to standard stress tests. An increase

in public capital spending, raising the net incurrence of liabilities to around 2.5 percent of
